top_signals.title: PacSun CEO: Brands Mean a Lot to Young People Today
top_signals.summary: Brieane Olson, CEO of PacSun, says that the retailer’s core customer is 16 to 24, while it is also tracking differences between Gen Z and Gen Alpha. Drawing on a PacSun Youth Report conducted with GlobalData and surveying 6,000 young people, Olson said mental health ranks as their top priority. She cited PACSUN’s ongoing partnership with Selena Gomez and the Rare Impact Foundation as an example of collaborations intended to have lasting value for young customers. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close" on October 29, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: New Balance CEO Joe Preston on NYC Marathon Partnership
top_signals.summary: Joe Preston, New Balance President and CEO, discussed the company’s long-running partnership with the New York City Marathon, which he described as a key part of the brand. More than 300 New Balance associates are in the city for race week, including 200 retail staff at the Javits Center expo, where more than 100,000 visitors are expected over three days. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close" on October 29, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)
